gates.value: 3P: the hand is on the magazine from 0.12 s (palm on the left face, fingers round the front), pulls it, the magazine falls from the hand at MagDrop, the hand goes to the belt and comes back with the new magazine in hand, rides it in and returns to the handguard; the empty reload goes round the left side of the receiver to the charging handle and rides it back. FP: the gun comes up for the reload; the hand pulls the magazine, drops below the frame to the pouch and comes back, and seats the magazine in view.
gates.threshold: hand carries the magazine, nothing floats, nothing through the gun
gates.note: FP: the UEFN arms render all orange and the upper arm's open shell shows at the left edge during the reload; the new magazine is small at the bottom edge between 1.0 and 1.2 s

honest_notes: Third person plays no body reload clip now (option (i) of the plan): the gun stays in the hold and only the left arm reloads.
The pouch is a point at the left front of the belt (PouchOffset (32, -9, 26) cm from the pelvis in the pawn's axes); there is no pouch mesh.
Builds ran with UBT -NoHotReloadFromIDE because the user's CardShopLab editor (another project) held the engine's Live Coding mutex; DemoGame_1 itself was closed throughout.
